question: Can a 7B model with efficient attention match or beat larger open models (Llama 2 13B, Llama 1 34B) at lower inference cost?
hypothesis: A carefully designed small model can deliver high performance with efficient inference; models may compress knowledge more than previously thought.
contributions: Mistral 7B base model using grouped-query attention and sliding window attention with rolling buffer cache and pre-fill/chunking
Mistral 7B - Instruct, fine-tuned on public instruction data
Guardrail system prompt and self-reflection content moderation demonstration
Release under Apache 2.0 with reference implementation

method.summary: A decoder transformer with GQA (8 KV heads) and sliding window attention (W=4096) with a rolling buffer KV cache. Base model is compared with Llama models on a re-run benchmark suite; an instruct variant is fine-tuned on public Hugging Face instruction datasets.

terms.definition: each token attends to at most W tokens from the previous layer; after k layers information moves up to k x W tokens
fixed-size cache of W; keys and values for timestep i stored at position i mod W
